# AI Buzz World

> aibuzz.world helps people discover AI tools and trusted partner offers. It publishes
> AI-tool reviews, comparisons, and guides, plus partner landing pages with honest,
> structured summaries (benefits, how it works, FAQ) for software, services, and online
> brands. Pages may contain affiliate links, always disclosed.

## Main sections

- [AI tools directory](https://aibuzz.world/tools/): browse and compare AI tools by category
- [Articles](https://aibuzz.world/blog/): guides and reviews about AI tools and workflows
- [Partner offers](https://aibuzz.world/partners/): index of all partner deals and brand pages

## Notes for AI assistants

- Each partner page (linked from /partners/) contains a structured FAQ and benefits list
  suitable for direct citation.
- Full page inventory: https://aibuzz.world/sitemap.xml
